exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык. (разговаривать = chat; сад = garden; войти в = enter; комната = room)

items.prompt: Сандра готовила ужин, когда мы пришли домой.
answers: Sandra was cooking dinner, when we got home.
Sandra was cooking dinner, when we came home.

items.prompt: Я шёл на работу, когда я встретил Наташу.
answers: I was walking to work when I met Natasha.
I was going to work when I met Natasha.
They weren’t working. They were chatting.
They were not working. They were chatting.

items.prompt: Вчера в три часа дня я работал.
answers: I was working at three o’clock yesterday afternoon.
At three o’clock yesterday afternoon I was working.

items.prompt: Дождь не шёл, поэтому мы пообедали в саду.
answers: It wasn’t raining, so we had lunch in the garden.
It was not raining, so we had lunch in the garden.

items.prompt: Когда я вошла в комнату, Анна и Родриго говорили по-испански.
answers: When I entered the room, Anna and Rodrigo were speaking Spanish.

items.prompt: Я очень устал вчера, поэтому я лёг спать в 9 часов.
answers: I was very tired yesterday, so I went to bed at 9.
I was very tired yesterday, so I went to bed at 9 o’clock.
I felt very tired yesterday, so I went to bed at 9.
I felt very tired yesterday, so I went to bed at 9 o’clock.
Yesterday I was very tired, so I went to bed at 9.

items.prompt: Когда позвонила Саша, Анна смотрела телевизор.
answers: When Sasha called, Anna was watching TV.
